monitor.title: Interoperability Pipeline Monitor
monitor.subtitle: Live Hackathon Demonstration: Watch how our middleware bridges the independent Revenue XML system with the Social Welfare eligibility engine without replacing underlying legacy databases.
monitor.clickToPopulate: Click 'Run Live Interoperability Flow' above to populate live payloads for this step.
monitor.rawXmlTitle: Revenue Department Raw Legacy XML Output

step1.name: 1. Welfare Application Init
step1.description: Citizen submits scheme application with Welfare ID

step2.name: 2. JWT & RBAC Auth Check
step2.description: Middleware validates JWT bearer token and role permissions

step3.name: 3. Digital Consent Verification
step3.description: Middleware checks active unexpired consent record

step4.name: 4. Master ID Mapping
step4.description: Maps Welfare ID (CIT-1001) to Revenue ID (REV-7845)

step6.name: 6. Legacy XML Received
step6.description: Revenue system returns raw XML format response

step7.name: 7. XML → JSON Common Model
step7.description: Transforms legacy XML into standardized JSON payload

step8.name: 8. Data Quality Validation
step8.description: Executes 6 schema & non-negative income quality checks

step9.name: 9. Deterministic Rules Engine
step9.description: Evaluates scheme income and age thresholds

step10.name: 10. Final Result & Audit Log
step10.description: Updates status, records immutable audit event, sends notification
